notes.title: Major Update #1 – Shift to Isometric View
notes.content: [h2]What's new?[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]1) The Game is Now in Isometric View[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594617/f6da72bbcf60c0178f4375d4b8a7cb07d9eba64b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Before, it looked like this:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594617/bb2b036bff7f42ebe7c5990f2f607368784a6cee.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Room designs have been completely reworked.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594617/3cae0edf5aae225b779b3d1dd40f53a61cd82e63.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594617/ad8f8afebcbf089ba12e4b7f4cd4e1cd72ad5429.jpg"][/img]The castle layout has also been redesigned.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]2) New Castle Structure[/b][/h3][p]The castle got way more complex:[/p][list][*][p]The Vampire Skuf’s room has been transformed into a [b]Throne Room[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]2 new great halls[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]3 entrances[/b] to the castle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]4 different paths[/b] leading to the Throne Room.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594617/dd96d541db33e18e3168f7f59760274668cf50d5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]New Throne Room:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594617/9ae5475de85edaed0589da4a656f3cf606caa622.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In the old version, the castle was [b]linear[/b] with just [b]1 entrance[/b] and [b]1 corridor[/b] to the Throne Room:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594617/b68b322409ca0118824403db630ae70a06a520da.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Old Vampire’s Room:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594617/ea698a859ac068bb45acc354fb5bfd09ab50e8f5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]3) Adventurer Update[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Adventurers no longer march along a boring linear path – now they [b]wander the castle using random routes[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]They don’t stand in queues anymore: adventurers [b]go around each other[/b], attack from different angles, and [b]split up[/b] while some are fighting monsters and others are already pushing further inside.[/p][/*][*][p]Adventurers now [b]start their journey from different entrances[/b] to the castle.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]4) Room Mechanics Update[/b][/h3][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594617/574c583e89120e6ef7d841f09e92d06788dd66d3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594617/c0d4298ba70886f141f401ce8f9f91003dd00e2a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594617/73dfb905b7c2f094d4770240bb020101ba5a73d7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594617/2d6e65ca422d9e0836616ded97fe1ace727e754a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594617/cdaedf0707f91c7bd5f87fe63add78540d2bc309.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594617/d6d9b426f766920b2e6485bc19c8044198485007.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594617/aee720e73e2312403e65dacf670d446c361ad684.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594617/0848086c71dce100902498276137480530e9034c.png"][/img][/carousel][list][*][p]If a room is already busy with adventurers, the rest just run through without stopping.[/p][/*][*][p]Lava Room – now deals delayed fire damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Spike Room – deals contact damage from each spike.[/p][/*][*][p]Pitfall Room – deals massive contact damage, but has a long cooldown.[/p][/*][*][p]Crossbow Room – now does small AoE damage with super-fast reloads.[/p][/*][*][p]Computer & Board Game Rooms – now stall adventurers for a long time.[/p][/*][*][p]Large Arena – actually large now (2x bigger than normal rooms) and can only be placed inside a Great Hall. On the Arena, up to 4 adventurers and 4 monsters can battle at the same time.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]5) Other changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Torches now have animation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with incorrect display of health bars for monsters and adventurers[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with the inability to pick up coins[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the size of the buttons with the main actions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with the lack of an icon for the cancel action button[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Is the Old Version Still Playable?[/h2][p]Yes! You can still play the legacy build. ːsteamthumbsupː[/p][p]To do this, go to the game page in your Steam library, click on settings -> properties. In the properties, go to the Beta versions section and select the [i][b]Legacy[/b][/i] version.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594617/2616ded429fbaadc1a275e352bcc2fadd4c56946.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594617/46bd1ea24dc822bc0a50fc8fdd734bab3df867ad.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Done — the game will run in version [b]0.6.1[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594617/e2fa48a6f4fc810e231ef6bc2e96c18c320daaca.jpg"][/img][/p][p]To switch back to the new version, go to Properties again → Betas tab → select [b]None[/b].[/p]

notes.title: Patch #3
notes.content:
- Added screen mode setting
- Windowed mode can now be resized

notes.title: Update #1 - New Adventurers, Monsters, Abilities and Game Rebalance
notes.content:
[h1]List of changes[/h1]
[b]New content:[/b]
- 6 new monsters
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594617/b250d6674065c73409db2d8e569b467acc7c7b25.png[/img]
- 3 new adventurers
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594617/70d6e8a276ff81951bde865dffe8e703999f2283.png[/img]
- Added 50 waves on easy and normal difficulty (previously there was only easy difficulty with 20 waves)
- Added abilities to adventurers and monsters
- Rebalanced monster leveling
- Rebalanced prices for building rooms, summoning monsters and leveling them
- Rebalanced monster acquisition

[b]Minor changes:[/b]
- Display of damage, healing and effects
- Display of health bars for adventurers and monsters
- Dropped loot is now grouped by 1/10/50/100 (improved optimization and eliminated visual bugs)
